ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters accounting for approximately 10-15% of the total visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. High-frequency, discrete white circular spots (mottling) distributed across the central and lower regions of both lobes against the dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible wide V-shaped depression at the center; the angle is approximately 105 degrees with a moderate pixel depth relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes compared to the right lobe, which shows more rhythmic, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated spatial distribution of small, circular white pixel clusters and rings (rosettes) scattered throughout the dark pigmented regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-intensity linear pixel streaks observed on the right lobe, oriented diagonally towards the outer tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged indentation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe, suggesting non-uniform tissue loss or historic trauma.
